## Decision

Draft prerequisite trust-root repair.

## Observed defect

PR Steward currently validates a proof self-reference exception by comparing the declared proof paths with the entire PR diff. That works only for proof-only PRs. It rejects the intended ordinary pattern where implementation reaches validated head `I`, then a final proof-only commit `P` pins evidence to `I`.

PR #1140 currently demonstrates the contradiction: its final commit changes only `PROOF.json`, but the full PR also includes policy code and tests, so the existing exception cannot validate it.

## Scope

Implement `TP-PRSTEWARD-PROOF-PIN-RANGE-SEMANTICS-001`:

- derive deterministic commit-range evidence from recorded implementation SHA to current PR head;
- accept only a contiguous, non-merge, proof-only final suffix;
- reject all post-validation source/test/schema/workflow/config changes;
- preserve all existing audit, CI, reviewer, thread, harvest, and security-release gates;
- add adversarial regression tests including the #1140-shaped case.

## Authority boundary

- Draft only.
- No merge-readiness claim.
- No merges, closures, force pushes, branch deletion, or runtime mutation.
- Independent exact-head audit is required because this changes proof authority.

## Relationship

This PR is a prerequisite for truthful readiness evaluation of #1140. Do not merge #1140 first merely because its CI is green.
